prompt: A young adult East Asian woman sitting on a white bed in a high-end hotel bedroom, shot from above the head to mid-thigh. Subject is centered slightly to the left, body slightly sideways and leaning forward, legs together and angled toward the bottom left, hands relaxed and folded on the knees. Shoulders naturally down, head tilted slightly to the left, looking directly at the camera with a soft, quiet gaze and a subtle natural smile, lips relaxed and closed. She has a delicate oval face, deep brown almond eyes, natural thin brows, a slender nose bridge, and coral nude-pink lips. Light makeup, skin is fair and warm-toned, retaining real pores, fine vellus hair, slight skin tone variations, and natural sebum highlights, no plastic skin smoothing. Long dark black hair, center-parted or slightly off-center, smoothly falling to chest and waist, thick volume with a few loose strands. She wears a white or cream-white slim-fit knit short dress, fine vertical ribbing, long sleeves, wrap-style deep V-neck, neckline naturally slipping to the shoulders to show collarbones and neck; hem reaches upper thighs, soft form-fitting fabric with real stretch textures and natural folds, overall subtle, elegant, and cozy. Background is a modern hotel bedroom: white pillows and fluffy bedding, gray-brown upholstered headboard, light gray wall panels; on the right is a wooden nightstand and a warm yellow lamp with a soft cream-white shade providing warm ambient light. Main light is soft natural window light from the front-left, with the bedside lamp providing warm-toned side-back fill, creating a cold-warm balance. Overall low saturation, low contrast, cream white and warm beige tones, soft shadows, natural skin tones. Photography style: 50mm or 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, slight high-angle shot, shallow depth of field, clear eyes, soft background blur, real knit and bedding textures, slight ISO 400 film grain, soft highlight bloom, photorealistic. Avoid: CG, anime, illustration, excessive skin smoothing, heavy makeup, exaggerated figure, incorrect fingers, deformed arms, stiff poses, excessive exposure, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered room, text, watermarks, logos.

promptZh: 一位年轻的东亚女性坐在 高端酒店卧室的白色床上，镜头视角从头部上方到大腿中部。主体略微偏左，身体微侧并向前倾，双腿并拢斜向左下方，双手放松交叠在膝盖上。双肩自然下垂，头部微向左倾，直视镜头，眼神柔和安静，带着淡淡的自然微笑，双唇放松闭合。她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸，深棕色杏眼，自然的细眉，鼻梁修长，珊瑚裸粉色嘴唇。淡妆，肤色白皙且呈暖色调，保留真实的毛孔、细微的绒毛、轻微的肤色差异以及自然的皮脂光泽，无塑料感磨皮。深黑色长发，中分或微偏分，顺滑地垂至胸前和腰间，发量浓密，带有几缕碎发。她穿着 白色或米白色修身针织短裙，带有细竖条纹，长袖，裹身式深 V 领，领口自然滑落至肩部，露出锁骨和颈部；裙摆垂至大腿上部，柔软的贴身面料呈现真实的弹力纹理和自然褶皱，整体风格低调、优雅且舒适。背景为现代酒店卧室：白色枕头和蓬松的床上用品，灰棕色软包床头板，浅灰色墙板；右侧是一个木质床头柜和一盏暖黄色台灯，柔和的米白色灯罩营造出温暖的环境光。主光源为左前方柔和的自然窗光，床头灯提供暖色调的侧后方补光，形成冷暖平衡。整体低饱和度，低对比度，奶油白与暖米色调，阴影柔和，肤色自然。摄影风格：50mm 或 85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8，轻微高角度拍摄，浅景深，眼神清晰，背景虚化柔和，真实的针织和床品纹理，轻微 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，柔和的高光晕染，照片级真实感。避免：CG、动漫、插画、过度磨皮、浓妆、夸张的身材、手指错误、手臂变形、姿势僵硬、过度曝光、强 HDR、过度锐化、杂乱的房间、文字、水印、Logo。
